== Printing-specific Revised face ==
The source linked below documents the actual white-border face used here. Printed wording follows that face; the source image and disclosed preparation remain accessible from its File page. Existing identities, version navigation, release-date citations and independently sourced rulings are preserved. The former illustration remains in its existing File history; this source correction does not establish a new executable state or a gameplay implementation defect. The physical card ends its printed game text with “you must forfeit Needa first.” The existing explanatory sentence about choosing forfeits is preserved verbatim under Rulings with its separate Glossary version 2.0 (November 1998), p. 32 source; it is not printed on this card.
